statement: Let \(x, y\) be real numbers satisfying \(x - 3\sqrt{x+1} = 3\sqrt{y+2} - y\). Find the greatest and smallest values of \(P = x + y\).

Let \((O)\) be a fixed circle of radius \(R\) with fixed points \(A, B\) inside it such that \(A, B, O\) are non-collinear. A variable point \(C\) lies on \((O)\) (\(C \neq A, B\)). Construct circles \((O_1), (O_2)\) through \(A, B\) tangent to \(BC, AC\) at \(C\) respectively. Let \(D\) be the second intersection of \((O_1)\) and \((O_2)\). Prove that:\\
a) \(CD \leq R\).\\
b) The line \(CD\) passes through a fixed point independent of \(C\).

Let \(A_1A_2A_3A_4A_5A_6A_7A_8\) be a convex octagon with no three diagonals concurrent. Call the intersection of any two diagonals a \emph{button}, and call a convex quadrilateral formed by four vertices a \emph{sub-quadrilateral}. Find the smallest \(n\) such that we can color \(n\) buttons so that for all \(i \neq k\), the number \(s(i,k)\) of sub-quadrilaterals with vertices \(A_i, A_k\) whose diagonal intersection is a colored button is the same.

Find all functions \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\) satisfying
\[f(f(x-y)) = f(x) \cdot f(y) - f(x) + f(y) - xy.\]
Find all triples of natural numbers \((x, y, n)\) satisfying \(\dfrac{x! + y!}{n!} = 3^n\) (with \(0! = 1\)).

Let \(\{x_n\}\) be defined by \(x_1 = a\) and \(x_{n+1} = 3x_n^3 - 7x_n^2 + 5x_n\) for all \(n = 1, 2, 3, \ldots\), where \(a\) is a real number. Find all \(a\) for which \(\{x_n\}\) has a finite limit as \(n \to +\infty\), and find the limit in each case.
